```{r setup}
# shared.R is already sourced by the note chunk above
library(reactable)

senators <- load_senators()
ns       <- senator_name_sets(senators)
bills    <- load_bills()
votes    <- load_all_votes(ns)

# Render one committee's vote table (or a note if it has no votes yet).
# Summaries only — the full roll call for each vote lives on the bill's
# own page. Date sorts chronologically, Bill sorts by number.
vote_table <- function(code) {
  dat <- votes[[code]]
  if (is.null(dat)) {
    cat("No votes have been taken in this committee yet.")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  tbl <- dat |>
    left_join(bills |> select(bill_measure, url_slug), by = c("Bill" = "bill_measure")) |>
    mutate(bill_no = suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("SB-", "", Bill)))) |>
    select(Date, bill_no, Vote, Result, Dem_percent_sign, Rep_percent_sign, url_slug) |>
    arrange(desc(Date))

  legsim_table(
    tbl |> select(-url_slug),
    page_size = 20,
    columns = list(
      Date = colDef(format = LEGSIM_DATE, width = 100),
      bill_no = colDef(
        name = "Bill", width = 90,
        cell = link_cell("SB-", ifelse(is.na(tbl$url_slug), NA,
                                       file.path(BILL_PAGES_DIR, paste0(tbl$url_slug, ".html"))))
      ),
      Vote = colDef(name = "Vote (Aye-No-Abstain-Absent)", minWidth = 130),
      Result = colDef(width = 90),
      Dem_percent_sign = colDef(name = "Democrat Support", width = 100),
      Rep_percent_sign = colDef(name = "Republican Support", width = 100)
    )
  )
}
```
